profile.headline: Digital Marketer | Front-end Web Developer | UX Designer | Air National Guard | Vue.JS, React.JS, TypeScript | Secret Clearance
profile.summary:
I am a front-end web developer with over five years of experience in creating engaging and responsive websites and applications for various clients and industries. I have a bachelor's degree in web design and development, a nano degree in front end web development, a certificate in film/video production and editing, and a certificate in Foundations of UX Design by Google, with 6 more on the way! 

In my role, I demonstrate proficiency in a variety of cutting-edge technologies, including Vue.js, Nuxt 3, and React.JS, to deliver top-notch web solutions. My experience in web design significantly contributes to enhancing the user experience and visual appeal of the projects I undertake. In addition to my technical skills, I possess strong leadership and communication abilities, developed during an ongoing 12-year career as a Materials Manager in the Air National Guard, where I managed inventory and carried out administrative duties. Also might be worth mentioning that I hold a Secret Clearance through the Department of Defense.

I am passionate about learning new technologies and techniques to improve my web development skills, and I am always looking for new and exciting challenges and opportunities to grow as a web developer and a professional.

positions.title: UX Designer | Front-end Web Developer
positions.description: Specializing in front-end development at Hyperreal, I work with new and potential clients to thoroughly understand their needs and aspirations for their online presence. At Hyperreal, we use some of the latest technologies with our tech stack mainly consisting of Vue.js, Nuxt 3, Tailwind CSS, & TypeScript, among others. I work closely with the Hyperreal team and clients to bring their visions to reality. My tasks range from designing to coding the frontend features & user experience for each project we take on.
positions.insights: Skills: JavaScript · TypeScript · HTML5 · SCSS · Vue.js · Front-End Development · Nuxt.js · Responsive Web Design · npm · Tailwind CSS · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS)

positions.title: Materials Manager
positions.description: Performs administrative and management functions. Performs and monitors management (and procedural application) of manual or automated inventory control actions. Computes and accumulates data for use in analysis. Helps develop work standards and methodology. Performs inventories, and ensures timely correction of discrepancies. Prepares, analyses, and evaluates reports, procedures, and policy data. Provides customer service. Inspects and evaluates inventory management activities. Periodically inspects activities for compliance with policies, procedures, and directives for accuracy. Analyzes reports and records activities, reports inefficiencies to supervisors, and recommends corrective actions to improve operations. Evaluates supply efficiency and equipment management activities. Uses management products to evaluate accounts. Provides support to maintenance activities. Coordinates with maintenance activities on repairable component actions. Controls and issues bench stock property. Obtains material required for equipment modification, periodic component exchange, and bills of material in support of maintenance. Accounts for all items contained in mobility readiness spares packages. Inspects and identifies property. Inspects conditions of property received. Compares property with procurement specifications. Identifies property, using technical data and blueprints, and identifies components to subassemblies. Performs shelf life inspections of stock. Performs technical material functions. Plans use of storage facilities. Inventories supplies and equipment. Prepares statements of facts surrounding property loss, damage, or destruction through causes other than fair wear and tear. Establishes property locator system. Issues, delivers, and transfers property. Plans and schedules materiel storage and distribution activities. Ensures availability, and controls use of space, materiel handling equipment, and required spare parts.

positions.title: UX Designer | Front-end Web Developer
positions.description:
In my role as a Front-End Developer with TekPartners/Inspyr Solutions, I was entrusted with the responsibility of collaborating closely with clients to ensure their project objectives were met efficiently. My primary duties involved diligently completing assigned tickets for each sprint, meticulously documenting the methods and strategies employed in my tasks. I actively participated in weekly meetings, where we engaged in detailed discussions about the progress of tickets, identifying potential challenges, and brainstorming effective solutions. The tech stack I primarily utilized with my client was Vue.js and Bootstrap.

In between clients, It was my duty to remain up to date on other technologies like React.JS, Next.JS, & Microsoft Azure, to name a few, through paid & free courses.
positions.insights: Skills: JavaScript · Bootstrap · React.js · HTML5 · Vue.js · Front-End Development · Responsive Web Design · npm · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS)

positions.title: Front-end Web Developer
positions.description:
In my role as a Front-end Developer at Direct Wines, I was responsible for the production, updating, and maintenance of five U.S. brand websites, as well as four Australian brands. My workflow was organized in two-week sprints, and each day began with a stand-up meeting where we discussed new tickets, potential obstacles, and strategies for addressing bugs and challenges. Each ticket completed would be thoroughly tested by senior developers to ensure the ticket requirements were met. Collaboration was a key part of my role, working closely with designers and various departments to ensure delivery of pixel-perfect code within tight deadlines.

As a Release Manager, I oversaw the entire release process, ensuring that all tickets were thoroughly tested, approved, and ready for deployment. This role also included extensive post-release testing in live environments. My technical expertise extended to writing unit and end-to-end tests using Cypress.JS, often executed immediately after live updates, and creating A/B tests for various promotions using Optimizely, along with managing their performance tracking.

My experience at Direct Wines also involved creating and monitoring new tags in Google Tag Manager, contributing to our robust digital footprint. My technical toolkit included proficiency in React.JS, HTML, SCSS, JavaScript, jQuery, JavaServer Pages (JSP), SourceTree, & Jira, each contributing significantly to our team's success in delivering sophisticated and responsive web experiences.
positions.insights: Skills: JavaScript · jQuery · Google Tag Manager · JavaServer Pages (JSP) · React.js · HTML5 · SCSS · Sourcetree · Schema · Front-End Development · Responsive Web Design · npm · Cypress · Release Management · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · Jira

positions.title: Data Technician
positions.description: Collect and manage data from thousands of Sikorsky employees. Assistant in deployment of phones and printers. Set up printers and phones to specific users. Keep Sikorsky employees up to date with new upcoming projects.

positions.title: Service Support Worker
positions.description: Coordinated special events and themes such as holiday parties and annual Mud Run. Received, stored and shipped goods and materials. Recommended merchandise to customers based on their needs and preferences. Maintenance around Camp Pendleton MCX's.

positions.title: Screen Marker
positions.description: Marked start and end times of each individual interview. Provided assistance in finding errors in recorded focus groups. Entered data into Excel for pharmaceutical projects. Answered incoming correspondence.

positions.title: Photo Lab Technician/Supervisor
positions.description: Provide excellent customer service: prioritize orders, maintain in-depth knowledge of current photo products and services, resolve customer inquiries and complaints promptly, and establish professional relationships with customers to build sales through suggestive selling, soliciting business accounts, local events and promotions. Perform all functions necessary to open and close the Photo Lab. Develop, price and package photo orders. Maintain a neat and organized Photo Lab and storage area. Schedule, perform and monitor all daily/weekly/monthly equipment maintenance activities to minimize machine malfunctions and downtime. Prevent all photo markdowns from exceeding to the established minimum standard by identifying opportunities and developing improvement plans as necessary. Ensure the Photo Lab and all employees who process film, follow Federal and State laws and OSHA regulations. Make recommendations for improved Photo Lab performance and implement plans. Oversee and operate all equipment, kiosks and technologies associated with the Photo Lab. Ensure employees are following all Loss Prevention policies to minimize Shrink in the Photo Lab, and react to all signs of internal and external theft. Maintain an in-stock position on all Photo Lab supplies. Work with the Store Manager to anticipate inventory needs based on seasonal and local events. Coordinate and track Training and Certification of all Photo Lab employees. Assign, prioritize, and follow up on tasks to Photo Lab employees, while providing direction and feedback. Communicate and work effectively with the Store Team, Regional Category Specialist, District Manager and Qualex Account Development Specialist. Work with the Store Manager to create a weekly Photo Lab schedule based on processing volume to meet customer service standards. Perform all Front Store and Pharmacy activities assigned by the Store Manager.
